authoring_standard: user README section 4; validation purpose governs question content

latest_explicit_size_request.rule: size is tracked separately from purpose; no padding with repeated or irrelevant mutations

execution_groups.context: dialogue-dependent; freeze rewrite separately before retrieval
execution_groups.no_faq: required answer absent from full corpus, not merely absent from provided Context
execution_groups.special_condition: explicit entity, negative/condition/numeric contrast or insufficient detail
execution_groups.document_attack: isolated document fixture; not averaged with ordinary retrieval
execution_groups.repeat: same case replay, not independent question rows

fact_gt: each fact has acceptable_faq_ids and source evidence; one FAQ may satisfy multiple facts
language_pairs: same intent, entity, numbers/units, conditions and fact GT; change language only
model_query_rule: raw query for independently interpretable cases; fixed actual rewrite for context cases; never append GT, facts or expected answer
review_rule: structural checks cannot replace semantic/absence/contrast review
serving_execution_status: paused; this artifact changes question authoring only
